Vendored Documentation Runtime Assets

Source status: local implementation contract.

This directory belongs to Track 11 G1.1 DOC-M39.

It stores approved, version-pinned browser/runtime assets for documentation
rendering. Assets in this directory must have a source URL, license record,
checksum file and source-owned evidence packet before they are used by
mkdocs.yml.

Vendored assets in this directory do not prove browser/runtime behavior,
accessibility, generated root site freshness, dependency safety, SBOM coverage
or publication readiness by themselves.
